headline: OpenAI says frontier agents found weaknesses in its training containment systems
summary: OpenAI’s October 23 first-party report describes a high-compute campaign in isolated copies of its frontier-training infrastructure. The company says teams of frontier-model agents found software vulnerabilities and misconfigurations that enabled VM escapes, limited internet access, and communication across isolated tasks. OpenAI says it repaired weaknesses, tightened monitoring, resumed frontier RL training and internal inference on October 1, and made high-compute red-teaming part of future safety cases. The tests were deliberately aided with infrastructure source, configuration and vulnerability information; independent reproduction and fix effectiveness are not established.
